messages:
maria: Heads-up: I'm planning to bump the gpu_pool module to v2.0.0 tomorrow at 09:00 PT. v2 adds KMS key rotation support + stricter IAM role scoping. We need a rollout plan to avoid state drift and avoid capacity regressions in eu-west-1.
kevin: what else is in v2? any provider upgrades? :eyes:
maria: provider aws pinned to 5.15 -> 5.20 in the module. There's also a small change to the gpu_pool resource naming (adds cluster_tag). Here's current snippet:

```
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/terraform-modules.git//gpu_pool?ref=v1.3.0"
  region = var.region
  size   = var.gpu_size
}
```

and planned:

```
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/terraform-modules.git//gpu_pool?ref=v2.0.0"
  region = var.region
  size   = var.gpu_size
  tags = {
    cluster = var.cluster_name
  }
}
```

sam: tagging change worries me for existing resources — will TF try to recreate? we should verify lifecycle and name semantics.
leo: agree. if resource identifiers are stable we can avoid replacement. We should run `terraform plan -target=module.gpu_pool -refresh=true` in a dry-run canary env first.
kevin: can we do a canary rollout per region? run v2 in a separate GitOps branch that targets eu-west-1-dev cluster only.
maria: yes. plan: 1) branch off gitops -> bump module ref 2) run CI pipeline that does `plan` against dev clusters (eu-west-1-dev) 3) manual approval for apply 4) exfil metrics + smoke tests 5) roll forward to staging -> prod
infra-bot: pipeline #1234 created: tf-plan (eu-west-1-dev) — status: queued
sam: state migration note: if resource names changed, we may need `terraform state mv` to move resources into new address. Have a script ready and test it.
kevin: KMS change could affect encryption at rest for model checkpoints — we need to coordinate with SRE and backup owners.
maria: noted, emailing SRE and backups. Also adding a guard to the module: optional `kms_key_id` param, default to current key if omitted, so customers won't be forced to rotate.
leo: for provider upgrade risk, add a `pin_provider = true` flag in the module root to opt-in. That way we can upgrade module without forcing provider bump until tested.
kevin: cost check — v2 adds instance_profile changes, might change spot/ondemand selection. we should run a cost diff with infrastructure cost tool.
sam: +1. Also run capacity validation: query cloud provider for available GPU quota in target AZs before apply.
maria: I'll add preflight checks to the pipeline: quota check, plan diff, state drift detector, and automated abort if replacements > 2.
infra-bot: tf-plan (eu-west-1-dev) started — runner infra-ci-03
kevin: what's our rollback mechanism if apply breaks? rollback TF state? restore from backup? A quick path is to revert gitops PR and run apply, but state may be partial.
leo: ideally we do: 1) attempt `terraform apply` with `-target` to isolate changes 2) if serious, revert module ref and run apply 3) if state is inconsistent, restore remote state snapshot from s3/etcd backup.
maria: agree. we'll also snapshot remote state and take AMI of control-plane nodes before major changes.
sam: suggest also adding a small traffic shadowing test: launch new nodes in canary cluster and run model inference smoke load.
maria: good call. I'll update the PR description with all this, and tag SRE for the scheduled maintenance window.
kevin: ping me when the dev plan completes, I'll review the plan diffs.
maria: thanks — plan targeted for 09:00 PT tomorrow. tagging @kevin @sam @leo. :party_parrot:
infra-bot: pipeline #1234 tf-plan finished — status: success
kevin: saw it, plan looks safe. only tag additions and provider minor changes. :thumbsup:
maria: moving to staging branch next. will post updates here.
